name: pdf-workbench
displayName: Werkbank – PDF Editor, Redact & OCR with AI
description: Read, annotate, redact, merge, split and OCR PDFs in VS Code – offline, with the AI of your choice (Claude Code, Gemini, Ollama …).

commands.title: Werkbank: Add Claude Code hint to CLAUDE.md
Werkbank: Set up PDF tools for AI (MCP)
Werkbank: Show folder with texts and markings

werkbank.dataFolder.description: Folder in the project where the text, markings and study aids of each PDF are stored.

werkbank.openClaudeAfterPrompt.description: Automatically open Claude Code after copying a prompt.

werkbank.ai.provider.description: Which AI handles the tasks: claude-code, zwischenablage (clipboard only), openai, or the ID of a provider registered by another extension.

werkbank.ai.endpoint.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API. Examples: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai (Gemini), http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama).

werkbank.ai.model.description: Model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, gemini-2.0-flash or llama3.1.

werkbank.ai.maxChars.description: Maximum amount of PDF text (characters) sent to a provider.

werkbank.feedback.githubRepo.description: GitHub URL (https://github.com/Name/Repo) that problem reports go to. Empty: use the address from the extension's bugs/repository.

werkbank.feedback.email.description: Email address for problem reports and feedback.
